verses.1: And Eliphas said to me, “I will do it.”
verses.2: The serpent will harm the bird, because it will harm its offspring.
verses.3: May you be merciful, for you will be righteous. And if not, then follow your own ways.
verses.4: Your faith will save you; it will bring you victory in judgment.
verses.5: Your suffering is great, and there’s no end to your troubles.
verses.6: For your brothers will be taken captive, and their armor will be destroyed.
verses.7: It will not be filled with water; it will not be nourished by food.
verses.8: And a stranger shall possess the land, and he shall sit in it.
verses.9: You sent forth wind and seeds of destruction.
verses.10: Therefore, your surroundings are full of dangers, and you will be filled with fear suddenly.
verses.11: It’s dark, with nothing to be seen; the waters cover everything around you.
verses.12: He who is above heaven, and who sees the heads of stars, because they are scattered everywhere.
verses.13: And you said, “Who knows what the darkness will do?”
verses.14: He is covered with thick hair, and he cannot see. The heavens will move around him.
verses.15: May those who have walked through the world be preserved.
verses.16: They stood still, and no river flowed to wash away their sins.
verses.17: The words of El Sur from us, and what will happen to Shadai for that matter.
verses.18: And it is filled with goodness in their midst, while the wicked’s evilness is far from me.
verses.19: May the righteous fear and rejoice; may they be praised with sincerity.
verses.20: If we do not create and nourish ourselves, then fire will consume us.
verses.21: May the danger be with him, and may his punishment bring you good.
verses.22: Please take some of his teachings from him, and put his words into your heart.
verses.23: If you return to Shadai, it will build a wall between you and your tent.
verses.24: And in the valleys and ravines, there are streams and rivers.
verses.25: And there will be suffering and hardship for you, and gold will be scattered everywhere.
verses.26: For then, your heart will rejoice, and you will be brought before the Lord.
verses.27: I will speak to him, and he will listen to you. Then your requests will be granted.
verses.28: And it shall say, “And He will raise you up again. And upon your paths, light shall shine.”
verses.29: For they despised him, and said, “Let his eyes be opened.”
verses.30: He will be carried away by the wind, and he will be carried away into the wilderness.
